issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect Milkable.messageOnMilk() to be a no-argument method returning a String (see UML and textual description). The solution implements Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) (and the Seal/Goat implementations use this signature). This parameter mismatch will prevent students from matching the interface specified in the exercise and will cause compilation/signature errors when following the template/problem instructions (e.g., template Main calls m.messageOnMilk() with no argument).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable interface consistent with the problem statement and template. Either: (a) Change the solution so Milkable.messageOnMilk() has no parameters (String messageOnMilk()) and update Seal/Goat implementations to match (returning "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"); OR (b) If a volume parameter is desired, update the problem statement UML/text and the template (including Main) to require and call messageOnMilk(double volume). Prefer option (a) to align with the current exercise description and template.
